notes: §1985:XIV.3.3.4 GR5: with OUTPUT "the logical paths are activated for all destinations specified by the content of each occurrence of data-name-5 up to and including the occurrence specified by the content of data-name-1". BindPath binds ENABLE OUTPUT (SR3, COBOL6170), Emit calls MessageControl.Enable, SetOutput enables occurrences 1..DESTINATION COUNT (ValidCount: 30 outside 1..OCCURS), error keys 0/1/5, status 00/15/20/80, and Deliver then moves each enabled destination's held Outbound messages on. The witness enables D1-D2 of three with count 2, and SEND shows D3 still disabled. Probes at 85: (a/f) count 9999 30, count 0 and 4 30 on the DISABLE twin through the same SetOutput; (b) ENABLE count 3 with an unknown ZZ in occurrence 2: 20 '010', the known two enabled; ENABLE OUTPUT on an input CD refused COBOL6170; a SEND held for a disabled D1 is delivered at ENABLE (count 0 -> 1); (c) refused COBOL0902 at 2014/2023; (d,e) not applicable.

next.reason: 1985: "When the OUTPUT phrase is specified, the logical paths are activated for all destinations specified by the content of each"; 2023: "No 2023 clause holds the ENABLE statement or the communication module; the by-wording candidates are unrelated.". No 2023 clause holds the communication module or its ENABLE statement. The by-wording candidates (SET, RELEASE, WRITE and others) only share terms like data-name-5.
